title: Chapter 44 First Kill
content:
Chapter 44 First Kill

There were still many things in the warehouse in the stone house, which Huang Feiguang had not put into his backpack.

There were a lot of food, including wheat, corn, rice, and a lot of meat.

In addition to food, there were also many resources such as ores and wood.

These materials made Wang Shuo very happy, and at the same time, he had a basic judgment of Huang Feiguang's strength.

However, he must have brought all the important things with him.

There were no scrolls, weapons, and special props. Wang Shuo would never believe that Huang Feiguang did not have these things. After all, he should be rich.

Wang Shuo did not put these materials into his backpack immediately. As long as he defeated his opponent, these would be his. If he lost, there would be no point in getting these things now.

Wang Shuo then checked other buildings and facilities, even the kitchen and toilet.

Finally, he came to the farmland and found 5 breadfruit trees.

It seems that this is the source of the bread he traded with others in the trading house before.

The breadfruit tree is very thick, and a lot of water is stored in the trunk, and its fruit can be eaten as bread.

Wang Shuo picked one and found that the fruit contained a lot of starch.

Now is not the time to study food. After putting away the bread fruit, Wang Shuo took Gong Zheng and walked around Huang Feiguang's territory.

But he did not find anything else suspicious.

So Wang Shuo came to the mound and planned to wait.

Under the mound was a cave entrance, and at the entrance was a huge stone door, which showed traces of artificial construction, and it was built not long ago.

After waiting for a while, Wang Shuo realized that he was now in the opponent's territory, and the opponent would definitely be able to know his position through the enemy identification system of the map.

So he stopped pretending and showed his cards.

"Huang Feiguang, come out and talk to us?"

"Who are you? Why should I come out and talk to you?"

Huang Feiguang should know that it was Wang Shuo who invaded his territory.

After all, Wang Shuo got the system prompt.

"You are really a noble man who forgets things easily, I, Wang Shuo."

Wang Shuo loudly introduced himself so that the other party could recall.

Seeing his arrogance before, I thought he was a tough guy, but I didn't expect that he would become a coward without even seeing the enemy.

At this moment, Wang Shuo noticed that the number of people in the current area was decreasing rapidly.

There were thousands of people before, but now it has dropped to more than 700.

Wang Shuo only then realized how cold-blooded and cruel people can be in the face of survival.

"Agui, what will be the consequences if I let the other party go?"

"It is basically certain that Lord Zach will give both the enemy and us a countdown. When the countdown ends, both sides have not yet decided life and death, then both sides may be wiped out."

After a while, he wrote again: "At this time, you can't be merciful!"

Chang Gui didn't want Wang Shuo to get into trouble at this time!

After all, Wang Shuo now has a good hand, and his future is bright.

"If you don't come out, don't blame me for being rude!" Wang Shuo shouted loudly.

At this moment, Da Huang suddenly shouted loudly.

"Woof, woof."

Wang Shuo became alert. Is there any danger approaching?

Could it be that Huang Feiguang has arranged a back-up plan?

Wang Shuo immediately took out his bow and arrow and became alert.

At the same time, he ordered the golden armored warrior to slowly approach the direction indicated by Da Huang.

Located in Huang Feiguang's territory, Wang Shuo had no way to observe the situation of his territory through the map.

Could his territory also be invaded?

Suddenly, with a "whoosh", an iron arrow was shot from the direction of his territory. Wang Shuo did not react and was hit by the arrow.

A "-50" damage value floated above his head.

The huge impact of the arrow knocked Wang Shuo to the ground directly.

Gong Zheng was quick-witted and immediately raised his shield to protect Wang Shuo behind him.

"Fuck, he actually shot a cold arrow." Wang Shuo felt an inexplicable anger in his heart.

In the blink of an eye, the archer appeared in front of Wang Shuo riding a huge tiger.

A masked man, wearing a tights, with a short knife hanging on his waist and a bow and arrow in his hand.

Neither side said a word and started fighting directly.

The golden armored warrior faced the opponent's pet tiger, while Gong Zheng fought with the opponent himself.

Wang Shuo also shot an arrow at the enemy, but it did not hit.

Then he used the reconnaissance skill on him.

He found that the opponent was called Ichiro Fukuda, level 4, and all attributes were lower than his own.

Wang Shuo smiled contemptuously: "Just this, you dare to sneak attack me, you are simply looking for death!"

Wang Shuo directly took out a long sword and joined the battle.

Gong Zheng, who was only level 2, was still obviously at a disadvantage, although his basic attributes were also higher than Ichiro Fukuda.

But because he was a tool man, he was far less flexible than the opponent, and his main weapon was a shield, it was difficult to cause fatal damage to the opponent.

After Wang Shuo joined the battle, Ichiro Fukuda fell into a disadvantage directly.

Soon, Wang Shuo stabbed him with a sword, and his health began to decrease. Moreover, his right arm was injured, so his fighting ability was also affected.

At this moment, the golden-armored warrior also cut off the tiger's head with a sword. After all, the tiger was just an ordinary beast, and it had no chance of winning against the golden-armored warrior.

Ichiro Fukuda saw his mount being killed, and there was a look of despair in his eyes.

He never thought that it would end like this.

How could the opponent be so powerful, with a puppet with explosive combat power, and also recruited a subordinate.

He thought that he had a mount, so he could be one step faster and kill the opponent at a lightning speed.

And he was the first to attack, but he didn't expect that the opponent would crush him directly with his powerful force.

Ichiro Fukuda was defeated step by step, and Wang Shuo didn't intend to let him go. This was a fight to the death, and the opponent didn't mean to surrender.

Wang Shuo directly held the sword with both hands, jumped high, and chopped it heavily on the opponent's head.

Ichiro Fukuda's strength attribute was less than 10 points, while Wang Shuo had 15 points with the bonus of equipment.

Although Ichiro Fukuda held the knife with both hands and tried his best to resist, the sword still cut deeply into his left shoulder, and a "-53" damage floated above his head, indicating a fatal blow.

At this moment, he had lost his fighting ability and fell to the ground, wailing in pain.

"Do you have any last words?" Wang Shuo couldn't bear to see the other party in pain.

"Baga!"

Ichiro Fukuda suddenly jumped up and spit out a poison needle from his mouth.

Wang Shuo's pupils shrank and his breathing became rapid.

This change caught Wang Shuo off guard.

Just when Wang Shuo was about to be stabbed by the poison needle, Gong Zheng's iron shield blocked Wang Shuo in time, which saved him from danger.

While Wang Shuo was still in shock, Gong Zheng's iron shield also hit Ichiro Fukuda's head hard.

Suddenly, his health value was reset to zero.

Wang Shuo looked at the dead Ichiro Fukuda, and his heart was mixed for a while.

Sitting on the grass, he was silent for a long time.

The sadness on his face gradually disappeared, replaced by a look of determination.
